subject.title: feat(control-ui): render Mermaid code fences in webchat

question: Should OpenClaw accept built-in Mermaid SVG rendering in Control UI webchat, and if so what sanitizer, dependency, and proof constraints must the implementation satisfy before merge?
rationale: This is not only a mechanical rebase: it adds a large rendering dependency and a new untrusted-markdown-to-SVG boundary, so maintainers need to confirm the product/security direction before anyone revives the stale branch.

options.title: Port and narrow before merge
options.body: Require a current-main port in the markdown-it renderer, removal of the workspace override, scoped scheduling for every renderer surface, bindFunctions handling, and current-head browser/security proof.

options.title: Approve built-in Mermaid explicitly
options.body: A maintainer may choose to accept the dependency and SVG boundary after reviewing the sanitizer model, bundle impact, and upgrade/security implications.

options.title: Pause or replace
options.body: If the feature direction or branch cost is not worth carrying, close or pause this PR and invite a fresh narrow replacement against current main.

recommendation.title: Port and narrow before merge
recommendation.body: Require a current-main port in the markdown-it renderer, removal of the workspace override, scoped scheduling for every renderer surface, bindFunctions handling, and current-head browser/security proof.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev authored the current markdown-it renderer and sanitizer/test contract that a safe port must preserve.
